scripts.dev: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.111 preview
scripts.dev:vertical: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.111 preview vertical
scripts.check: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.111 check && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.111 check vertical
scripts.render: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.111 render --skill=product-launch-video --quality high -o ../out/launch-16x9.mp4 && node master.mjs ../out/launch-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run build && cd vertical && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.111 render --skill=product-launch-video --quality high -o ../../out/launch-9x16.mp4 && cd .. && node master.mjs ../out/launch-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:vertical
